system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"I enjoy my default pattern when wondering "is service X down" is to search for it on <USER> and see if others are complaining. Looks like <USER> is having some issues 😲 Showtunes will have to wait.."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Everything seems fine on our end. Can you try accessing it in a private or incognito window? Keep us posted!"
text: {"send_unedited": true, "reason": "Reply is friendly, clear, and offers a helpful troubleshooting step."}
